commands.name: Unlimited health
commands.description: Keeps the player's health full and prevents combat damage.

commands.name: Unlimited mana
commands.description: Refills mana and prevents spells from consuming it.

commands.name: One-hit kills
commands.description: Defeats enemies with a single damaging hit, even through armour.

commands.name: Set money
commands.description: Sets the gold balance from 0 to 1,000,000,000.

commands.name: XP multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies XP gained from pickups and quest rewards.

commands.name: Damage multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies the player's physical and spell damage before armour.

commands.name: Movement speed multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies the player's movement speed on foot, on water, and in flight.
